itineraries.title: Five days from Santorini
itineraries.intro: The southern Cyclades from the caldera.

days.note: Into the caldera at first light; the villages on the rim and the sunset at Oia.
Chora’s lanes at night; Mylopotas for the morning swim.
Chora on its cliff and the church above it; a quiet night at Karavostasis.
The white rocks of Sarakiniko and the fishing hamlet of Klima.
Into the caldera at first light; the villages on the rim and the sunset at Oia.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Mykonos to Santorini
itineraries.intro: The Cyclades from north to south, ending beneath the caldera.

days.note: Little Venice and the windmills; a quieter anchorage on the south coast for the night.
The sanctuary of Apollo, seen early before the excursion boats arrive.
The fishing harbour and the bars on the quay; a swim at Kolymbithres.
The Portara and the old town.
The Small Cyclades: white sand at Pori and the clearest water of the week.
Chora’s lanes at night; Mylopotas for the morning swim.
Into the caldera at first light; the villages on the rim and the sunset at Oia.
